kartvizit.aciklama: Create your digital business card and bio link page: save contact (vCard), QR code, link preview, contact form and visit analytics. Your Google review page is managed here too.
kartvizit.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's own cards and cards on behalf of clients; Google review pages and incoming messages. Messages from agency cards also become CRM leads.

liste.ara: Search by name, address or company
liste.bos: No cards yet. Create your first digital business card.
liste.silOnay: Delete "{{ad}}"? Deleted items can be restored from the trash.
liste.silindi: Deleted (can be restored from the trash)

duzenle.olusturuldu: Card created — you can now add images
duzenle.tanitimIpucu: Short intro: describe what you do in a sentence or two.
duzenle.dilIpucu: The card's own language: buttons and the form appear in this language (Arabic is right-to-left).
duzenle.slugIpucu: If the address changes, the old one redirects to the new one for {{gun}} days. The printed QR code always works.
duzenle.gorselOnceKaydet: Save the card first to upload images.
duzenle.gorselIpucu: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{mb}} MB. Images are resized on the server and converted to WebP; hidden data such as location is removed.
duzenle.haritaIpucu: Leave empty to build a Google Maps link from the address.
duzenle.sosyalIpucu: You can enter the full address or a username (@username).
duzenle.baglantilarBio: In the bio link layout this list appears at the top of the page as large buttons. Reorder by dragging or with the arrows.
duzenle.baglantilarKart: In the business card layout it appears below the contact details. Reorder by dragging or with the arrows.
duzenle.saatlerGoster: Show opening hours on the card
duzenle.aktif: Live (if off, the page does not open)
duzenle.formAcikAciklama: Visitors can leave their name and email/phone; messages go to "Card messages".
duzenle.indexAciklama: When off (recommended) the page is noindex: it is not listed on Google but opens via the link.
duzenle.sifreVar: This card is password protected. Enter a new password to change it, or remove the protection.
duzenle.sifreIpucu: Optional (at least 4 characters). A protected card shows no personal details in link previews.
duzenle.hesapIpucu: Leave empty and the card belongs to the agency; enter a client email to create it in the client's account.

analiz.botBilgi: Bots and link previews are not counted ({{sayi}} filtered out).
analiz.gizlilik: Visitors' IP addresses are not stored; a daily salted hash is used for unique counts.

mesajlar.aciklama: Submissions from the "Leave your details" form on your cards.
mesajlar.silOnay: Delete this message? It can be restored from the trash.

geriBildirimler.aciklama: Submissions from the "Send us private feedback" form on your review pages.

yorum.bos: No review pages yet. Create a page with a QR code for table cards or receipts.
yorum.politikaNotu: Under Google's rules, every customer is shown the same link.
yorum.politikaAciklama: Google prohibits asking for reviews selectively (only sending happy customers). The page never asks for a rating; the "Write a review on Google" button is visible to everyone, and private feedback is only an extra option.
yorum.placeIpucu: Your business's Google Place ID (starts with ChIJ…).
yorum.placeBul: Find the Place ID with Google's finder
yorum.tesekkurIpucu: Leave empty to show a short thank-you in the page's language.
yorum.geriBildirimAciklama: Appears below the Google button as an extra option; submissions go to your panel and trigger a notification.

hata.slug_ayrilmis: This address is reserved; choose another one.
hata.kart_siniri: You have reached your card limit (at most {{sinir}}).
hata.sayfa_siniri: You have reached your review page limit (at most {{sinir}}).

hata.dongu: A short link cannot point to another short link.
hata.cok_oge: At most {{en_cok}} items can be added.
hata.saat_gecersiz: Time must be in HH:MM format.
hata.gorsel_bicimi: Upload JPG, PNG or WebP only.
hata.gorsel_boyutu: The image is too small or too large.
